findings.claim: New namespace import `* as regexes` from `../core/regexes.js` — verify it is actually used in this file and that it does not introduce a circular import or defeat tree-shaking.
findings.rationale: The hunk only shows the import addition, so I cannot confirm usage. A namespace import pulls in the whole module (all regex definitions) rather than just the needed symbols, which can hurt tree-shaking in a library like zod; and `core/regexes.js` being pulled in from `classic/schemas.ts` could create a cycle if regexes (or its transitive deps) reference back into classic. Low confidence without the rest of the file, but worth a second look.
